# Sticky OS

> Free, open-source (MIT) firmware for the Seeed reTerminal Sticky, the 3.97-inch 800 x 480 touch e-paper board with an ESP32-S3. It gives the board a home screen of glanceable apps: clock, weather, calendar (Google, iCloud or Outlook iCal links), notes and voice notes, timer, photos, quote of the day, an e-reader (EPUB, MOBI, AZW3, FB2, PDF), recipes and eight games. Set up from the browser over USB or Bluetooth; no account and no cloud. It does not run on the reTerminal E1001 or E1002. Independent; not made by or affiliated with Seeed Studio.

- [Home: tour, apps, install, FAQ](https://sticky-os.space.fast/)
- [Setup app (Chrome or Edge)](https://sticky-os.space.fast/setup/)
- [Source, README and install steps](https://github.com/ovidiul/sticky-os)
- [Latest release](https://github.com/ovidiul/sticky-os/releases/latest)
